## Public-safety confirmation

```text
operator_approved_public_submission: yes | no
private_data_included: no
credentials_or_tokens_included: no
```

Do not submit private repository contents, client material, personal data,
credentials, private logs, browser/session state or hidden runtime state.
Feedback is evidence for evolution, not authority to change the kernel.
